q1_issues.issue: "that night" is an anaphoric temporal NP, which the instruction set resolves by term propagation to the bare day-part symbol `night` (plus the antecedent's day terms, none available here) — not to a coined deictic constant `that_night`, which is reserved for speech-anchored times like `tonight`.

q2_gaps: episodic indefinite bare plural argument ("prayers were held until dawn") — the plural machinery keys on the determiner (bare plural = generic kind / rule, definite plural = group witness) and gives no encoding for a bare plural naming specific participants in a one-off past clause; the bare class symbol is licensed only for a non-specific/generic object
notes: `mass_ceremony` fuses on the religious-Mass reading (a noun modifier classifying a subtype, hence head genus only and no modifier genus); on the alternative "large-scale" reading `mass` would be incidental size description and should not fuse at all. `(Patient sk_conduct_1 sk_ceremony_1)` is borderline — defensible as an occurrence brought about, but the instruction set's tie-break when the change test is unclear is `Theme`.
